title.zh: 就业、贫困与可持续发展

subtitle.en: Read employment projections and development targets without confusing them with measured outcomes.
subtitle.zh: 分清就业预测、发展目标与已经测得的结果。

overview.en: Development news asks whether people can live healthy lives, learn, earn a livelihood and participate in society. Economic growth is one input. Employment statistics measure particular populations and periods; projections of future job gaps answer a different question. This guide provides the measurement framework, not a current global unemployment total.
overview.zh: 发展新闻关心人们能否健康生活、学习、谋生并参与社会，经济增长只是其中一项条件。就业统计测量特定人群与时段，未来岗位缺口预测回答的是另一种问题。本篇解释测量框架，不提供当前全球失业总数。

takeaways.en: A future projected jobs gap is not today’s count of unemployed people.
takeaways.zh: 未来预测的岗位缺口，不是今天的失业人数。

takeaways.en: People outside the labour force are not all counted as unemployed.
takeaways.zh: 不在劳动力中的人，并非都计入失业人口。

takeaways.en: A development target, funded project and achieved outcome are separate claims.
takeaways.zh: 发展目标、获得资金的项目与已经实现的成果，是不同判断。

name.zh: 国际劳工组织与统计机构

role.zh: 定义并测量劳动力市场指标

position.en: ILO distinguishes employment, unemployment and being outside the labour force. Definitions and reference periods are essential when comparing reports.
position.zh: ILO区分就业、失业和不在劳动力中三类状态，比较报道时必须核对定义与统计时段。

position.en: Its Human Development Index combines health, education and income. The index intentionally broadens the lens beyond income, but does not capture every inequality or form of poverty.
position.zh: 人类发展指数结合健康、教育与收入，刻意超越单纯收入视角，但无法涵盖所有不平等或贫困形式。

name.zh: 各国政府与发展合作方

role.zh: 将共同目标转化为项目

position.en: The SDGs connect poverty, work, education, health and the environment. A global goal does not establish that a country has funded or met it.
position.zh: 可持续发展目标把贫困、工作、教育、健康与环境联系起来。存在全球目标，不代表某国已经拨款或达标。

roots.en: The development agenda expanded from a narrower focus on income toward capabilities and interconnected social and environmental goals. Reports can therefore use different measures for different purposes. A falling unemployment rate can coexist with exclusion from work; read participation and job quality alongside the headline rate.
roots.zh: 发展议程逐步从较窄的收入视角，扩展到人的能力及互相关联的社会、环境目标。因此，不同报告会为不同问题采用不同指标。失业率下降也可能与退出劳动力市场并存，应把参与情况与工作质量一同阅读。

detail.en: The Millennium Declaration led to eight goals targeting progress by 2015.
detail.zh: 《千年宣言》推动形成八项目标，以2015年为进展期限。

detail.en: UN members adopted a broader framework connecting social, economic and environmental progress.
detail.zh: 联合国会员国通过更广泛框架，把社会、经济与环境进展联系起来。

detail.en: The published explanation distinguishes working-age people in employment, unemployment and outside the labour force.
detail.zh: 该说明区分劳动年龄人口中的就业者、失业者与不在劳动力中者。

meaning.en: Employed plus unemployed people under the stated statistical definitions.
meaning.zh: 按指定统计定义计算的就业者与失业者之和。

meaning.en: Generally requires being without paid or profit-making work, seeking work and available to start; check the survey definition.
meaning.zh: 通常须符合没有有报酬或营利工作、正在求职且可开始工作等条件，须看调查定义。

meaning.en: A summary of health, education and income dimensions; it does not replace separate poverty and inequality measures.
meaning.zh: 健康、教育与收入维度的综合指标，不能代替独立的贫困与不平等测量。

readingLens.en: Is this a present measurement, forecast or policy ambition, and for which age group?
readingLens.zh: 这是当前测量、预测还是政策目标，涉及哪个年龄群体？

readingLens.en: What is the denominator: all young people, working-age people or the labour force?
readingLens.zh: 分母是所有青年、劳动年龄人口，还是劳动力？

readingLens.en: What changed for people: money pledged, jobs created, earnings, access or measured wellbeing?
readingLens.zh: 人们实际获得了什么变化：承诺资金、岗位、收入、服务准入，还是已测得的福祉改善？

sources.title: The 17 Sustainable Development Goals and their history
